emails.subject: Trip dates for your visa application
emails.body:
Hi Leila,

For the travel-history section of your visa application I need the dates of your trips. Could you send me the trip dates from your January–June 2025 itinerary records when you get a chance?

Thanks,
Marta Chen
Visa adviser, Northstar Visa Advisory
